description: Messy real-world gold corpus for adapter-200 Workstream B. Unlike labels.json (clean seeds, labels track current emission), these labels are the HUMAN ORACLE: the true public surface a reviewer would name. Divergences (F1 < 1.0) are measured evidence of comment/string/docstring/macro-substring leakage and feed the confidence re-table decision — this corpus is NOT CI-pinned. Report: cargo test --test gold_f1 gold_f1_messy_report -- --ignored --nocapture

files.note: Human truth: VERSION macro + Session struct + session_open function. `legacy_connect`/`old_init` appear only inside comments. Probe: c.rs has no block-comment tracking.
Human truth: ui namespace + Button class + render function. `OldWidget`/`old_render` appear only inside a block comment. Probe: cpp.rs only skips line comments.

Human truth: Service class + run method. Commented-out class/method and a string literal mimicking a declaration are NOT surface. Probe: java.rs tracks block comments; string-mimic line does not start with `public`.

Human truth: Client class + public methods connect/__repr__ + create function. `fake_in_docstring` is inside a docstring, `_close` is PEP-8-internal, commented `old_helper` is dead. Probe: python.rs has no docstring tracking.
Human truth: real_fn + string_probe. Comment/doc-comment/string-literal mentions of `pub fn` are NOT surface. Control case: syn-based adapter should score 1.000.

Human truth: currentHelper function + CURRENT binding. Commented exports are NOT surface. Probe: Next.js route-marker detection uses substring `contains`, so `// export async function generateMetadata()` is expected to leak as a route_export FP.
Human truth: one props macro line. The commented `defineProps` mention is NOT surface. Probe: vue.rs uses `contains("defineProps")`, so comments mentioning the macro are expected to leak.
Human truth: greet function + Router class. Commented decls and a string literal mimicking `public func` are NOT surface. Probe: CALIBRATION item 7 suspects swift comment/string leakage.

Human truth: add function + Router class (label uses the adapter's full-remainder emission, `Router {`, matching the clean-seed convention). Commented decls (incl. a commented `private fun` inside the class body) are NOT surface. Probe: kotlin.rs has no comment tracking; the block-comment `class OldRouter {` is expected to leak.

Human truth: Real class + genuine method only. Fake declarations in `//` line comments and a `/* ... */` block comment are NOT surface — the adapter is born-correct with comment tracking (rev-24/26 discipline). Expected clean.

Human truth: sessions table + session_count view only. Fake DDL in `--` line comments and `/* ... */` block comments is NOT surface — the adapter is born-correct with comment tracking (rev-24/26 discipline). Expected clean.

Human truth: one real resource only. Fake blocks in `#` and `//` line comments, a `/* ... */` block comment, and inside a `<<-EOF` heredoc body are NOT surface — the adapter is born-correct with comment and heredoc tracking (rev-24/26 discipline). Expected clean.

Human truth: Real contract + genuine function only. Fake declarations in `//` line comments, a `/* ... */` block comment, and function-shaped text inside a `///` NatSpec line are NOT surface — the adapter is born-correct with comment tracking (rev-24/26 discipline). Expected clean.

Human truth: Real class + genuine method only. Fake declarations in `//` line comments, a `/* ... */` block comment, and inside a triple-quoted string literal are NOT surface — the adapter is born-correct with comment, shebang, and triple-quote tracking (rev-24/26 discipline). Expected clean.

Human truth: Real struct + v field + genuine function only. Fake declarations in `#` line comments, `#= =#` block comments, and a docstring region are NOT surface — the adapter is born-correct with comment and docstring tracking (rev-24/26 discipline). Expected clean.

Human truth: real function only. Fake definitions in `#` line comments (incl. Roxygen #') and inside a string literal are NOT surface — the adapter is born-correct with comment tracking and requires an assignment-operator prefix before `function` (rev-24/26 discipline). Expected clean.

Human truth: Real struct + genuine method only. Fake declarations in `//` line comments, `///` doc comments, `//!` module comments, and `\` multi-line string literal lines are NOT surface — the adapter is born-correct with string-aware comment stripping and multi-line string skipping (rev-24/26 discipline). Expected clean.
